Copy one year of the growth module's output into the model's own arrays

growth_take_year.Rd

Under cohort growth a year's size-age transition, lengths, weights and growth parameters are only known once the population loop reaches that year, so they are written into the arrays the rest of the model reads one year at a time.

Usage

growth_take_year(dest, g, y, derive_waa)

Arguments

dest

Named list of the model's growth arrays, as growth_take_year returns them.

g

The growth module's output, from Get_Growth_Year.

y

Year index to copy.

derive_waa

Integer (0/1); whether the weight arrays are present.

Value

dest with year y filled.
